issue.title: Fix artifact read resolution for plan refs
issue.description: While consuming an approved plan, the audited artifact reader could not resolve a plan ref even though the plan CLI could show it. The first command suggested a provider-qualified kind, and the retry rejected that same kind as malformed. This blocks agents from using audited artifact reads for plan context.

task_type_fields.impact: Agents cannot record audited artifact reads/consumption edges for plan refs and have to fall back to `sase plan show`, losing the artifact-read audit path.
task_type_fields.location: sase artifact read / artifact reference resolver for plan refs
task_type_fields.repro: From a bob-cli workspace, run: `sase artifact read plan:202608/block_id_prompt_first_responder.md "Need plan"`; it prints `plan is missing its plugin prefix; use builtin@plan` and exits unknown_kind. Then run: `sase artifact read builtin@plan:202608/block_id_prompt_first_responder.md "Need plan"`; it exits `malformed artifact reference: validation: artifact reference kind must match [a-z][a-z0-9_-]*`. `sase plan show 202608/block_id_prompt_first_responder.md` succeeds.
